about: Bytecode acceptance for the parser-free runtime (lua-small). Scripts are compiled with the same build's luac; 'debug' keeps debug information, 'stripped' uses luac -s. Classification measured under GoldenGate; see tests/COMPACT.md.

requires_parser.hwsmoke: loads a text chunk to check source/bytecode round trips
requires_parser.hwdiag2: compiles large constant tables from generated source
requires_parser.hwtest: checks that a valid text chunk compiles
requires_parser.bytefile: generates and compiles a 9,000-statement source chunk
requires_parser.ioprobe: stock GoldenGate EOF abort (both runtimes); not a parser issue
requires_parser.files: stock GoldenGate EOF/text-translation failure (both runtimes); uses load(text)

requires_debug_info.coroutine: checks line numbers / names from debug information
requires_debug_info.cobeacon: generated from coroutine.lua; same debug-information checks

upstream_bytecode_note: literals also fails as precompiled bytecode on the full runtime (string-sharing check)
upstream_bytecode_ok_note: api, code, and main return early (no T harness / IIgs adaptation); exit and memory checks only
